title: Redesigning Neural Networks to Not be Confidently Wrong even to Strong Adversarial Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2611.27811v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Early deep learning models attempted to simulate visual perception using a neural hierarchy that alternated between two types of layer: one modelled on cortical simple cells (that was designed to increase selectivity), and one modelled on cortical complex cells (that aimed to increase tolerance). We show that such a neural network (NN) architecture, when implemented with novel components that are better able to learn selective and tolerant representations, is capable of accurate and robust image classification and improved alignment between the behaviour of the model and the perceptual abilities of humans. Firstly, the proposed models are shallow, fewer than ten layer-pairs, which is more consistent with the rapid feedforward object categorisation performed by the biological visual system. Secondly, they are far less prone to producing classification predictions with high confidence for samples from unknown classes or for image consist

translated_title: 重新设计神经网络：即使在强对抗攻击下也不会“自信地犯错”
translated_abstract: 早期的深度学习模型试图通过一种神经层级结构来模拟视觉感知，该结构在两种类型的层之间交替：一种模拟皮层简单细胞（旨在提高选择性），另一种模拟皮层复杂细胞（旨在提高容忍度）。我们证明，这种神经网络（NN）架构在采用能够更好学习选择性与容忍性表征的新型组件实现后，能够实现准确且鲁棒的图像分类，并改善了模型行为与人类感知能力之间的一致性。首先，所提出的模型是浅层的，层数少于十对，这更符合生物视觉系统所执行的快速前馈目标分类机制。其次，这些模型远不容易对来自未知类别的样本或图像不一致的情况产生高置信度的分类预测……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种模拟生物视觉皮层简单细胞与复杂细胞交替结构的浅层神经网络架构，通过能够学习选择性与容忍性表征的新型组件，实现了准确、鲁棒且与人类感知更一致的图像分类，并能有效抵御强对抗攻击，避免对未知类别样本做出高置信度的错误预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a shallow neural network architecture inspired by the alternating simple-cell/complex-cell structure of the biological visual cortex, which—with novel components that learn selective and tolerant representations—achieves accurate, robust, and human-aligned image classification while resisting strong adversarial attacks and avoiding confident misclassification on unknown-class samples.
